title: Don't clone the elements selectedcontent leaves out
body: When cloning an option into a selectedcontent element, leave script, SVG script, frame, iframe, embed, and object elements out of the copy using the new excludeDescendant argument of clone a node, instead of removing them afterwards. Cloning and then removing them still cloned their contents, so a custom element in an object element's fallback content was upgraded for nothing. Depends on https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1534.
